description.text: Teaching Objectives This program majoring in Western Economics. The program is designed to equip students with advanced skills in economic theoryand econometric. The emphasis is on development of students’ analytically skills, in particular their ability to identify key questions andto use theoretical and empirical tools to answer them. Internship Students will have the opportunities to be engaged in industrial collaborative projects, interview techniques, resume instructions andreview, visits to companies, and career consultation. Degree Awarded Qualified student will be granted Bachelor Degree of Economics by Shenyang University Future Career The graduates can work in the International trade transportation, insurance, customs clearance etc agencies, specialized foreign-tradecorporations, and import and export department's of foreign-owned enterprises.

duration.text: The Economics at Shenyang Unversity is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2500 USD/per year ￥ 18000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 2. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 3. Academic transcript of high school 4. Photocopy of 1st page to 8th page of your valid passport (Liaoning) With photo, passport number & expiration date and name included. For the regarding authority must make sure that there are at least two pages on the passport for the Chinese Embassy to stick the Visa paper and Immigration to stick the resident permit paper. 5. Sponsorship Certificate You can click here to download the sample

requirements.text: 1. Under the age of 35 2. A high school graduate or with equivalent qualification 3. Able to take courses in Chinese (passing the 3th level HSK), or to major in Aeronautical Engineering, International Economics and Trade, Telecomunications Engineering or Mechanical Engineering (taught at SAU in the English medium)
